name: google-business-profile-client-report
description: Builds the monthly Google Business Profile report a client reads, from live Google Business Profile data in your Coupler.io workspace — views on Search and Maps, calls, website clicks and direction requests scored against target, last month and last year, the rating and reviews with the reply record, what people searched to find the listing, a misses section that names problems first, and recommendations someone can be held to. Use when someone asks for a monthly local SEO or Google Business Profile report for a client, wants the local section of a client deck, asks "what do I tell the client about their Google listing", or needs several locations written up for one client — even when they never say "report". For agencies and in-house teams reporting upward. For the operator's own read use google-business-profile-performance-report. Google Business Profile only.
